SUMMARY:
- Mid-market product SaaS (B2B) building a product-facing chat assistant + semantic product search across help docs and product metadata. 2 primary workloads: chat (low-latency interactive) and embeddings for search/rerank.
- Started on Redwood Hosted API in Jan 2026; positive: response quality, streaming. Now in procurement for Dedicated (predictable throughput & isolation).

TIMELINE / RECENT ACTIVITY:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Samira) — discussed use cases, current baseline with existing provider, baseline costs. (Gmail thread-16292b7d-03).
- 2026-02-12: Product demo + hosted API quick POC kickoff. Fireflies ff-2026-02-12-8732. Engineering ran sample traffic for chat workload (avg session 350 tokens).
- 2026-02-25: Security review: provided SOC2 docs + draft answers (drive doc). Echelon asked for KMS + audit logs + EU residency option.
- 2026-03-03: Pricing deep-dive with AE + SE (Samira + Diego). Went over Dedicated commit tiers, burst, and overage mechanics. Fireflies ff-2026-03-03-4411.
- 2026-03-08: POC latency run: engineering requested Dedicated-like environment to validate p95 <120ms for 1k rps chat bursts. Submitted INF-1298 to request pre-prod Dedicated sizing.

POC / TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Workloads: low-latency chat (interactive support), embeddings (batch/nearline) for product search, occasional large reranking jobs.
- Targets: chat p95 <120ms on 512-token horizon; sustained 500-1,000 concurrent sessions during peak; embeddings bulk throughput of ~5k vectors/hr during nightly index.
- Model preferences: prefer open model family (quantized variants) but willing to test Redwood-curated variants. Need ability to pin model version for rollouts.
- Routing/fallback: want auto-fallback to cheaper variant if Dedicated capacity limited; canary rollout for model version changes.

PRICING / PACKAGING DISCUSSIONS (key negotiation points):
- Commit levels: Echelon proposed a 12-month committed capacity at 80 GPUs equivalent (monthly reservation) for predictable pricing; Redwood initial SOW proposed 60 GPU-equivalent commitment with 3-month ramp.
- Burst: must support burst to 130% of committed baseline for short windows (hours) without immediate overage charges; suggested buffer billing applied monthly rather than immediate per-minute overage.
- Overage: They want predictable overage slabs (tiered) rather than spot pricing. Proposed: first 20% overage billed at 1.25x committed rate, >20% at 1.6x.
- Ramp schedule: Echelon requests 6-month ramp: 40% of commit months 1-2, 70% months 3-4, 100% months 5-6. Also asked for credit protection if actual usage under ramp.
- Trial credits & POC: Requested 30k usage credit on Dedicated to run production-like latency tests; AE offered 15k credit + extended Hosted API trial for comparison.
- Term / Exit: Seek quarterly usage reporting + 60-day rollback option (scale down commit with penalty) in case of model/regression economics.
- Optimize add-on: interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to hit cost targets.

COST SENSITIVITY / BUSINESS IMPACT:
- Echelon currently spends ~$40k/mo on hosted provider for production chat & embeddings. Goal: reduce unit cost by ~30% while keeping p95 latency SLAs.
- Target ARR for Redwood: $150k-$400k depending on final commit and add-ons (console retention, advanced observability).

CUSTOMER COMMENTS / QUOTES:
- "We need predictable monthly unit economics — spikes are fine but we have to budget." — Head of Engineering (Maya Lin)
- "If Dedicated reduces our per-token cost and gives SSO + residency we can move quickly." — VP Product (Jon Park)

SECURITY / COMPLIANCE NOTES:
- Okta SSO required (SAML).
- Must present SOC2 Type II report & 12-month audit logs retention option.
- EU data residency: must confirm model hosting region + KMS key residency.

- SE to provision a temporary Dedicated-like sandbox for 2-week latency POC (ticket OPS-2104).

- If we can match ramp & burst terms, high probability (70%) to close May 2026.
